food.title: Eat nearby
food.p1: Seafood and cafés are a short walk from the Portuguese city core.
food.p2: Bring water on wall walks; full meals wait by the seafront.

q1.question: Is there an entry fee?
q1.answer: Depends on the site — the cistern has a ticket; many wall sections are free.

q2.question: How long do I need?
q2.answer: 30 to 90 minutes for most single stops; half a day for the full Portuguese core.

q3.question: Best time of day?
q3.answer: Morning for softer light in the cistern and cooler walls.

q4.question: Combine with what?
q4.answer: Cistern, walls, bastion and a seafront meal in one loop.

q5.question: Family-friendly?
q5.answer: Yes for walking ages; watch steps on the ramparts and slippery stone if wet.
